description.value: Country Grocer is a family-owned Vancouver Island grocery chain with deep roots in the Chemainus community, emphasizing locally-sourced BC products and supporting local events and initiatives. The Chemainus location offers a full-service supermarket experience including deli, sushi, bakery, seafood, and fresh floral departments. It is part of an eleven-store Island chain that has served the region since the mid-1980s.
